rationale: Keep Alpha Generation, LLC as the canonical legal identity for AlphaGen and as an active U.S. infrastructure portfolio company. The official company site expressly defines Alpha Generation, LLC and AlphaGen as the same business, while the existing canonical redirect already preserves the former 'Alpha Generation (AlphaGen)' seed identity. Correct the corporate headquarters to Houston, add the official website, and replace the undisclosed ADIA stake with the 16.8% indirect interest disclosed by the New York Public Service Commission. Preserve ArcLight Energy Partners Fund VII and ADIA as active owners. CPP Investments' October 2025 transaction remains signed-pending rather than active because the official announcement and January 2026 regulatory ruling establish a proposed minority transfer, but no public closing confirmation was found by August 3, 2026; the separate AlphaGen duplicate task will reconcile that pending transaction and duplicate record.
